resources.name: All-electron full-potential DFT code with GGA+U (e.g., WIEN2K, FLEUR, Elk)

access.notes: Any all-electron FLAPW code supporting GGA+U with spin polarization is acceptable.
Lattice parameters a=3.92 Å, c=3.37 Å, space group P4/mmm, with Nd at (0,0,0.5), Ni at (0.5,0.5,0), O at (0,0.5,0) and (0.5,0,0). Public knowledge from experimental literature.
